prompts.mist: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: Agency Bloom mobile theme reference image and subtle scenic background. Create a refined editorial landscape photograph in PORTRAIT 2:3 composition for the theme Morning Mist / 晨雾. A quiet lake at early morning entirely wrapped in delicate pale silver-white mist, faint distant sage-green hills barely visible, a few soft reeds low at the edge. Cool ivory, mist grey, desaturated sage. Light is diffuse and pearly, with NO orange, pink sunset, sunrise sun disc or golden sky. Restrained, luminous, tranquil, real atmosphere and beautiful natural texture. Most of the upper two thirds is softly open foggy negative space; the gentle landscape sits in the lower third so the central band still reads clearly in a thumbnail crop. No people, buildings, lettering, UI, borders, frames, watermarks or logos. The image should unmistakably mean morning fog, rather than a generic mountain sunset.
